20261121-physics-g07-1.title: ubude obongezwayo bungakanani ngeecm
20261121-physics-g07-1.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-ubude obongezwayo bungakanani ngeecm ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261121-physics-g07-1.material: Umntu wafaka ubunzima obuyi-2 N kwintwasahlobo kwaza ubude baqhamba nge-3 cm ukusuka kubude bokuqala. Xa kufakwa ubunzima obuyi-6 N kule ntwasahlobo, ubude obongezwayo bungakanani ngeecm? (Ngaphakathi komda we-elasticity)
20261121-physics-g07-1.s.s1.prompt: Umntu wafaka ubunzima obuyi-2 N kwintwasahlobo kwaza ubude baqhamba nge-3 cm ukusuka kubude bokuqala. Xa kufakwa ubunzima obuyi-6 N kule ntwasahlobo, ubude obongezwayo bungakanani ngeecm? (Ngaphakathi komda we-elasticity)
20261121-physics-g07-1.s.s1.explain: Ngokomthetho kaHooke, ngaphakathi komda we-elasticity, ubude obongezwayo bulingana namandla (ubunzima) asetyenzisiweyo. Kuba amandla aye aba kathathu, ubude obongezwayo $3\text{ cm} \times 3 = 9\text{ cm}$.
20261121-physics-g07-1.s.s1.hint.0: Ngokomthetho kaHooke, amandla e-elastic nobude obongezwayo zilingana namandla ($F = kx$).
20261121-physics-g07-1.s.s1.hint.1: Amandla enyuke ngamaxesha angama-3 (2 N → 6 N).

20261122-physics-g07-2.s.s1.prompt: Ibhola yentsimbi enobunzima obuyi-10 N emoyeni intywiliselwe ngokupheleleyo emanzini kwaye ukufundwa kwesikali sentwasahlobo yi-8 N. Amandla okuntanta awafumanayo ibhola yentsimbi emanzini angakanani?

20261121-physics-g08-2.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-xa kwakhiwa iirelwe zekhephu ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261121-physics-g08-2.material: Kutheni, xa kwakhiwa iirelwe zekhephu, kushiywa isithuba (isikhewu) esithile phakathi kwerelwe nerelwe kwindawo edibana kuyo?
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: Kutheni, xa kwakhiwa iirelwe zekhephu, kushiywa isithuba (isikhewu) esithile phakathi kwerelwe nerelwe kwindawo edibana kuyo?
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.explain: Isinyithi siyanda ngobude ngenxa yolwandiso lobushushu xa ubushushu bunyuka. Ukuba akushiywa sikhewu sidibaniso, irelwe eyandisiweyo ehlotyeni ingatyhalana ibangele ingozi yokukhutshwa kwekhephu.
20261121-physics-g08-2.s.s1.hint.0: Izinto ezininzi eziqinileyo ziyandisa umthamo nobude xa ubushushu bunyuka.

20261122-physics-g08-1.title: Uhlalutyo lwesekethe oluqhubekekayo
20261122-physics-g08-1.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Uhlalutyo lwesekethe oluqhubekekayo ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-physics-g08-1.material: [Uhlalutyo lwesekethe oluqhubekekayo] Ukumelana okuyi-6 Ω nokuyi-3 Ω kudityaniswe ngokufanayo kwaza kwadityaniswa kunikezelo lwamandla lwe-12 V. Umbane opheleleyo ohamba kuyo yonke le sekethe ungakanani?
20261122-physics-g08-1.s.s1.prompt: [Uhlalutyo lwesekethe oluqhubekekayo] Ukumelana okuyi-6 Ω nokuyi-3 Ω kudityaniswe ngokufanayo kwaza kwadityaniswa kunikezelo lwamandla lwe-12 V. Umbane opheleleyo ohamba kuyo yonke le sekethe ungakanani?
20261122-physics-g08-1.s.s1.explain: Ukumelana okudityanisiweyo kwi-parallel $\frac{1}{R_p} = \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{2} \implies R_p = 2\,\Omega$. Umbane opheleleyo $I = \frac{12\text{ V}}{2\,\Omega} = 6\text{ A}$.
20261122-physics-g08-1.s.s1.hint.0: Ukumelana okudityanisiweyo kwi-parallel: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/3 = 3/6 = 1/2, ngoko R = 2 Ω.
20261122-physics-g08-1.s.s1.hint.1: Bala umbane opheleleyo I = V / R = 12 / 2.

20261122-physics-g08-2.title: ngokulinganiswa ngokufanelekileyo
20261122-physics-g08-2.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-ngokulinganiswa ngokufanelekileyo ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-physics-g08-2.material: Ibhotile yokugcina isiselo esishushu ixesha elide inendawo engenanto ('vacuum') phakathi kweendonga ezimbini kwaye ingaphakathi lifakwe isilivere. Zeziphi iindlela zokudluliselwa kobushushu ezivalelwa zezi zinto, ngokulinganiswa ngokufanelekileyo?
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: Ibhotile yokugcina isiselo esishushu ixesha elide inendawo engenanto ('vacuum') phakathi kweendonga ezimbini kwaye ingaphakathi lifakwe isilivere. Zeziphi iindlela zokudluliselwa kobushushu ezivalelwa zezi zinto, ngokulinganiswa ngokufanelekileyo?
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.explain: Umaleko we-vacuum awunamlinganiselo, ngoko ivala ukuhambisa ubushushu ngokuqhuba nge-convection, kwaye iindonga ezikhazimlayo zesilivere zibonisa ubushushu berediyeshini yohlobo lwe-infrared ngaphakathi, zithintele ukulahleka kobushushu.
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.hint.0: I-vacuum ayinanto, ngoko ivala ukuqhuba kunye ne-convection ngenxa yento.
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.hint.1: Isilivere sibonisa ubushushu berediyeshini, eyingcambu yombane-magnethi (infrared).
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.o.o0: Idonga lokuphindwe kabini elineyakuum: livala ukuhambisa ubushushu ngokuqhuba kunye ne-convection / ingaphakathi elinesilivere: livala ukulahleka kobushushu ngerediyeshini
20261122-physics-g08-2.s.s1.o.o1: Idonga elineyakuum: livala irediyeshini / ingaphakathi elinesilivere: livala ukuqhuba
